'''Hikokamiwake-no-Mikoto''' (彦神別命) is a [[kami (Shinto)]] deity found in [[:en:folk traditions|folk traditions]] and is associated with the [[Suwa Shrine]].
[[File:Yokoyamajyo.jpg|thumb|220px|right|Torii with the inscription "Takeminakata & Minomikotohikokamiwake Shrine," written by Prince Arisugawa Takahito.]]

== Overview ==
Hikokamiwake-no-Mikoto is enshrined at the [[Takeminakata & Minomikotohikokamiwake Shrine]], a [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Shikinaisha]] (Ranked as a [[Myōjin Taisha]]) located in [[Minochi district]] of [[Shinano Province]]. This kami is regarded as the eldest son of [[Takeminakata]].<ref>Norikawa Kazuhiko, "Supplement to Suwa Clan Genealogy," *Suwa Clan Genealogy, Volume 1*, Kōtarō Iida, Taisho 10, p. 14.</ref>

The deity first appears in literature in the fifth year of [[Empress Jitō]] (691 CE), when it is recorded that "Minouchi-no-Kami" was enshrined in Shinano Province at the emperor's command.<ref>*Nihon Shoki*, Jitō 5th year, 8th month, 23rd day entry.</ref> While this "Minouchi-no-Kami" does not appear in the *Engishiki*, it is widely believed to refer to Takeminakata & Minomikotohikokamiwake Shrine, the only major shrine in the Minochi District.

Hikokamiwake-no-Mikoto is generally considered the offspring of [[Takeminakata]] and [[Yasakatome|Yasakatome no Kami]].

== Genealogy ==
Hikokamiwake-no-Mikoto is the child of [[Takeminakata]] and [[Yasakatome|Yasakatome no Kami]]. His offspring include [[Niwatsume no Kami]], [[Mase no Kami]], [[Yasurao no Mikoto]], [[Chino no Mikoto]], [[Sanatsurahime no Mikoto]] (alternatively identified as Sanatsurao no Mikoto), and [[Takehikoneno Mikoto]].

== Descendant Clans ==
One of the deity's children, Chino no Mikoto, is traditionally believed to be the ancestor of the [[Chino clan]].{{efn|Chino River Myojin, erected November 18, Showa 40, reads: "The deified ancestor of the Chino clan is Chino no Mikoto, a descendant of Takeminakata no Mikoto and Hikokamiwake-no-Mikoto."}}

== Shrines Dedicated to the Deity ==
* [[Takeminakata & Minomikotohikokamiwake Shrine]] ([[Shinshūshinmachi]], [[Nagano (city)|Nagano City]])
* [[Tsumakusa Shrine|Tsumashina Shrine]] (Nagano City, Minami Nagano)
* [[Suwa Taisha Kamisha Maemiya Wakamisosha]] ([[Miyagawa|Miyakawa]], [[Chino, Nagano]])
* Suwa Taisha Shimosha Harumiya Wakamiya Shrine ([[Shimosuwa]], [[Suwa District, Nagano|Suwa District]])
* Suwa Taisha Shimosha Akimiya Wakamiya Shrine (Suwa District, Shimosuwa)
